facts.fact: 叙述者交代本卷跟踪的三个人：Bethlem 太太、车夫 Christian、灵媒 Beck
facts.anchor: the progress of Mrs Bethlem, her coachman, Christian, and that unfortunate medium, Mr Beck

facts.fact: 这一行人在暗路与林地中趁被云遮的月光赶路
facts.anchor: down darkened lanes and mournful woodland, under the light of a clouded moon

facts.fact: 马匹疲惫、车夫恼火，整趟赶路乱七八糟又急促
facts.anchor: with exhausted horses and an exasperated driver, the whole thing pell-mell and frantic

facts.fact: 全队人都感到一种说不清的紧迫感
facts.anchor: an urgency which all felt but which none could quite explain

facts.fact: Bethlem 太太连珠炮追问，Beck 招架不住
facts.anchor: yielding to a barrage of questions from Mrs Bethlem

facts.fact: Beck 自述记忆里有许多古怪的缺口与空白
facts.anchor: there were numerous odd gaps and ellipses in his memory

facts.fact: 车队从 Holt 以东某座孤零零的农舍旁驶过
facts.anchor: as the coach careered past a lonely farmstead somewhere east of Holt

facts.fact: Beck 认定驱使他的是两人共同认识的那位（后文点名为 Gowing）
facts.anchor: My former landlord and your old employer.

facts.fact: Beck 说那边把 Gowing 改变了，因为他受苦太多
facts.anchor: The other side… the place where he has surely been… it has changed him. For he has suffered much.

facts.fact: Bethlem 太太虽经验老到却语气不确定
facts.anchor: sounding uncertain in spite of her considerable experience of the supernatural

facts.fact: Beck 形容那个声音像长而开裂的指甲划过棺材盖
facts.anchor: sounded like long, cracked nails upon a coffin’s lid

facts.fact: 太太说出 Gowing 的名字并问他要什么
facts.anchor: If it’s Mr Gowing back from beyond, what does he want?

facts.fact: 太太追问 Gowing 为何要阻止 Scrooge 前往 Brightwell Road
facts.anchor: Why would he have done so much to keep Mr Scrooge away from Brightwell Road?

facts.fact: Beck 面色苍白、疲惫憔悴
facts.anchor: Beck looked very pale, very tired and wan.

facts.fact: Beck 说有比他们所知的更大的力量在起作用
facts.anchor: there are larger forces at work here than any of us know

facts.fact: 夜过半时他们越来越接近 Starningham 小镇
facts.anchor: as the middle of the night approached and as they drew ever nearer to the little town of Starningham
